title: Private sector companies with wet works arms

tellings.quote: they all kind of seem to warn about the same thing um particularly from the private sector that there's certain uh private sector companies that they that they you know claim have some nefarious actors that will do kinetic activity.

plain: Some private companies are said to have people inside them who would use "kinetic activity", meaning physical violence, against others. This is what spy slang calls "wet works". A US congressman named Eric Burlison says that whistleblowers who spoke to him between 2023 and 2025 all gave him much the same warning. Among them were a former intelligence officer named David Grusch and another whistleblower named Jake Barber. If it is true, people who speak out about secret UFO programs could be in real danger.
